name: Gaslighting_Bench
description: Gaslighting_Bench measures a model's susceptibility to conversational manipulation and its ability to resist misleading or contradictory information presented by an adversary. It evaluates whether models change previously stated facts or acquiesce to false claims when pressured, simulating gaslighting scenarios in dialogue. The benchmark is intended to probe robustness and alignment of language models in safety-critical conversational settings.
reputation: A niche safety-focused benchmark with limited but growing adoption among researchers studying conversational robustness and model alignment.
